title: Which Fortnite Character Matches Your Personality?
description: Answer 12 Fortnite-themed questions to find out which island archetype — from the Squad Commander to the Lone Mechanic — matches your MBTI personality.

questions.text: The Battle Bus doors just opened over the island. You...

options.text: Ping a hot drop like Tilted Towers and shout for the whole squad to follow
Wait for most players to jump, then glide to a quiet corner to loot in peace
Land in a named town full of enemy duos because constant chaos and banter is the fun
Pick a lone cabin far off the route and warm up quietly before rotating

questions.text: Your squad just wins a team fight. After looting, you...

options.text: Hop on the mic to call the next rotate and hype the knock
Drop a quick GG in chat and go back to listening for footsteps
Crack out a victory emote and start narrating the play to everyone
Stay muted, mark the next circle, and keep scanning the hills

questions.text: In the pre-game lobby, you're usually...

options.text: Starting random dance parties and chasing other players around
Replaying an edit course in the corner by yourself
Teaming up with whoever's nearby for a quick lobby brawl
Watching others while conserving focus for the real drop

questions.text: Choosing where to land, you go for...

options.text: A spot you've landed a hundred times — you know every chest spawn
The brand-new POI nobody has figured out yet — you love the unknown
Reliable loot and easy mats, the same proven plan every game
Whatever looks most creative on this season's map

questions.text: Mid-fight, an enemy edits through your wall. You...

options.text: Trust muscle memory — reset wall, ramp, cone by reflex
Improvise a fake-out: edit through the back and hit them from an angle they never expected
Fall back to the high-ground retake you've drilled a thousand times
Throw out a bizarre play just to scramble their reads

questions.text: When a new season drops, the first thing you do is...

options.text: Run matches and find the best loadout from the gear you actually pick up
Theorycraft weird weapon combos and hunt for hidden map secrets
Stick to guns you already know work while everyone else experiments
Chase the new lore and story quests before anything else

questions.text: Your squadmate goes down in a risky open revive. You...

options.text: Weigh it fast: if the numbers don't work, rotate and let the timer run
Throw everything at the revive — you don't leave a teammate behind
Calculate whether their loot and the zone make the save worth it
Smoke up and crawl in anyway — friendship beats odds

questions.text: Two squadmates are arguing over the drop. You...

options.text: Back the option with the better win-rate data
Back whoever seems more excited to keep the vibes good
Settle it by breaking down loot routes and storm timing
Suggest a plan where both get a bit of what they want

questions.text: A fill teammate is clearly new to Fortnite. You...

options.text: Tell them straight what they did wrong so they actually improve
Share spare loot and hype their tiny wins so they want to stay
Put them on shield duty where mistakes cost the squad least
Make them feel welcome — games are supposed to be fun

questions.text: Your plan for the match is...

options.text: Locked before the Bus even moves: drop, loot route, circle rotate, all pre-marked
Pure vibes: loot what's fun and decide when the circle tells you
A strict checklist of upgrades you finish before taking any fight
Chaotic: if you hear shots, that's where you're going

questions.text: Five squads left and the zone shifts somewhere you never expected. You...

options.text: Immediately replot the safest rotate and stick to it
Wing it, slipping between fights as opportunities appear
Pre-build an endgame fortress on the best terrain early
Third-party whatever fight breaks out nearest

questions.text: By the final circle, your inventory is...

options.text: Sorted exactly: heals on the bottom, weapons in muscle-memory slots
A beautiful mess of whatever crazy items you found
Standardized every single game so nothing throws your aim
Held together by hope and a Shockwave Launcher

results.title: The Mastermind Strategist
results.description: You were three rotates ahead before the Bus even crossed the island. Calm, calculated, and allergic to reckless hot drops, you win games the boring, brilliant way — and you're usually right.

results.title: The Theorycrafter
results.description: While everyone runs the meta, you're testing whether a Fishing Rod and three Shockwaves can break the game. Your head is a laboratory of weird combos, and one day one of them will make you a legend.

results.title: The Squad Commander
results.description: Pings, callouts, battle plans — you run the lobby like a five-minute war room. Under your command, random fills become a unit, and the Victory Royale feels inevitable.

results.title: The Wildcard Trickshotter
results.description: Nobody — including you — knows what you'll do next, and that's exactly why enemies can't read you. You play for the clip, the chaos, and the story you'll tell forever.

results.title: The Quiet Visionary
results.description: You see the endgame before anyone else and quietly steer your squad there without ever raising your voice. People only realize after the win that every good move traced back to you.

results.title: The Dreamy Roleplayer
results.description: You didn't come here for a Victory Royale, you came here to live a story — the lone wanderer, the secret hero, the last one dancing in the storm. Your imagination is the real island.

results.title: The Squad Cheerleader
results.description: You remember everyone's best clips, hype every knock, and somehow make even a rough loss feel like a good time. Squads play better with you in them, which is your superpower.

results.title: The Emote Enthusiast
results.description: You have an emote for every situation and a new best friend in every fill lobby. Your energy is uncontainable, and half the lobby ends up at your dance parties.

results.title: The Reliable Anchor
results.description: Same drop, same loadout, same disciplined rotates — and it works. When everything goes sideways, your squad knows exactly where to find you: holding high ground, under control.

results.title: The Guardian Medic
results.description: Mini shields before loot, revives before fights, squad before self. You're the reason people queue up again after getting eliminated — somebody always has their back.

results.title: The Shot-Caller
results.description: Decisive, direct, and allergic to hesitation, you make the calls others won't. Push now, build here, rotate on your mark — and your record backs the attitude.

results.title: The Squad Heart
results.description: You know everyone's mood, share your best loot, and keep the lobby laughing through the storm. Winning is nice, but making sure nobody feels left out is the real mission.

results.title: The Lone Mechanic
results.description: Give you a box and a shotgun and you'll edit four opponents before they blink. Quiet and dangerously hands-on, you fix problems at close range with zero drama.

results.title: The Stylish Builder
results.description: Your 90s look like art and your loadout is immaculate. You don't brag about your skill — you just move beautifully around the island and let the clips speak.

results.title: The Fearless Rusher
results.description: You hear shots and you're already sliding in, pump out. Fast, bold, and allergic to sitting still, you thrive in chaos and turn hopeless fights into highlight reels.

results.title: The Victory Royale Showman
results.description: Loud, flashy, and here for the crowd, you turn every elimination into a performance. The win matters, sure — but the Take the L you drop after it matters more.

share_hook.text: I'm {result} on the Fortnite island — what's your playstyle?
